scope: One sequential paired synthetic experiment, not production or isolated latency benchmark
notes: Original llama-server was stopped during early base evaluation to reduce memory pressure.
Machine memory pressure and background activity varied; timings do not establish causal or stable speedup.
No prompt-only short-output ablation, broad document test, or general capability regression was run.
Another llama-server process was present at cleanup; exclusive GPU use was not assured. The redundant restoration process created by this experiment was stopped.
